cohort: The study included 140 cases of histologically confirmed placenta accreta spectrum from singleton, non-anomalous pregnancies with suspicion for the condition, managed at a single institution from January 2010 to December 2022.
finding: Obesity (BMI >30 kg/m2) was independently associated with unrecognized placenta percreta, and concurrent pre-operative MRI in obese patients increased placenta percreta detection.
